name: Totals by topic for individuals, territorial authorities and local boards, 2013, 2018, and 2023 Censuses
dq_selection: Variables raTotal+ra00+ra01+ra02+ra03+ra04+ra05+ra06+ra07+ra08+ra80+raTS+ra99; areas = the 67 shipped territorial-authority codes + 999 + 999999; years 2013+2018+2023.
confidentiality: Counts are subject to Stats NZ confidentiality rules and random rounding to base 3 (RR3).
notes: The subject population is the census usually resident population. Religious affiliation is a total-responses variable: each person is counted once in every level-1 group they stated. The product excludes 999 (Area Outside Territorial Authority) and 999999 (New Zealand total by territorial authority/local board).
